headline: Macklemore releases new song supporting Palestinian mothers and children in Gaza
label: NEWS
caption:
American rapper Macklemore has released a new song dedicated to supporting Palestinian mothers and children in Gaza.

According to Middle East Monitor and Anadolu reports, the artist turns his grief over the situation in Gaza into music.

The track focuses heavily on the struggles faced by families and children caught in the conflict.

Macklemore has consistently used his platform to speak out on the humanitarian crisis in Gaza.
